reviews.outcome: Local index error [ZACH-IC-01](source-errors/findings/ZACH-IC-01.json). Fixed-point proof depends on representation of substitution; that prerequisite was identified. Concrete derivability conditions and imported CRT proof are not fully supplied. The text shares Avigad material, so agreement is not independent corroboration.  The proof checker stores witness terms, one-slot bodies and explicit finite contexts; enumerable axioms carry finite certificates. No additional serious defect confirmed in the adopted coding scope. The corrected output-bound minimization proof supplies the repair for AVIGAD-CI-01. Prime, least-common-multiple and CRT prerequisites are not imported without proof. The corpus uses its fixed seven-axiom language and its specified derived order; agreement on standard natural numbers is used without claiming the source order is equivalent in every Q-model. No new serious defect confirmed in the selected representability scope.  No serious defect found in these selected self-reference passages. Strong numeralwise representation supplies existence and uniqueness at the single standard diagonal input; no global function symbol for diagonalization is assumed. No new serious defect confirmed in the selected first-incompleteness arguments. Finite numeral cuts justify the bounded Rosser cases without induction in Q. Section 5.6, p. 118, explicitly asks the reader to assume the concrete derivability conditions; this is a scope limit, not a source bug, and is not treated as a proof of the corpus coding’s PA conditions.
